articles.title: Carney set to attend the United Nations General Assembly in New York next week
articles.summary: OTTAWA — Prime Minister Mark Carney is set to attend the United Nations General Assembly next week as geopolitical instability, war and U.S. President Donald Trump's efforts to dismantle the multilateral order hang over the event.

articles.title: Man, 61, dead after car and dump truck collide in Caledon, police say
articles.summary: A 61-year-old man is dead after a car and dump truck collided in Caledon early Friday, police say.

articles.title: Duncan Sheik, Tony- and Grammy-winning ‘Spring Awakening’ composer and pop star, dies at 56
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Duncan Sheik, the Tony- and Grammy-winning singer-songwriter who crafted the music for “Spring Awakening,” has died. He was 56.

articles.title: VIA Rail ending service at Guildwood and Malton stations starting Oct. 25
articles.summary: VIA Rail will be dropping service to Guildwood and Malton stations starting Oct. 25. The decision has drawn criticism from local commuters, though VIA Rail maintains the change is justified by the stops' proximity to Union Station and existing GO Transit connections.

articles.title: 'Don't close, don't sell': Union implores Stellantis to keep Brampton plant as automaker signals sale
articles.summary: The union representing Canadian workers at Stellantis is urging the automaker to keep its commitment to retooling its Brampton Ont., plant as the company looks poised to sell it instead.

articles.title: Police officers could be coming back to schools in York Region after program previously scrapped
articles.summary: Trustees from the York Region District School Board (YRDSB) have passed a motion giving staff six months to report back on how to bring back a program that puts police officers in schools.
